launches.title: Syncly Social  - Find Creators by What's Actually in Their Content
launches.tagline: AI-powered creator discovery that searches inside videos, not just profiles
launches.body:
Hey YC! 👋

I'm Joseph, co-founder of[ Syncly](https://syncly.app/social?utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=influencer-discovery) - we're building an AI social listening tool. Today, we're launching **Creator Discovery**, a new way for brands and agencies to find the right influencers by analyzing what's actually inside their content.

# **TL;DR:**

* 🎯 Describe your ideal creator in plain English – Syncly finds them by analyzing video content, not just profiles
* 🔍 Search by visual aesthetic, storytelling style, spoken mentions, and more - things no filter can capture
* 🚀 Discover organic brand advocates who mention you without tags or hashtags
* ⚡ What used to take hours of manual scrolling now takes seconds

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99264&key=user_uploads/971454/b5ed5c9d-8ded-464c-b93f-ff4ce144df33)

**Ask:** If you run influencer marketing at a brand or agency,[ try it free](https://social.syncly.app/login?utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=influencer-discovery) and tell us what you think. We'd love your feedback.

**Offer:** Book a demo through Launch YC, and we'll include a personalized social listening audit alongside your creator discovery walkthrough →[ Book a demo](https://syncly.app/demo?utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=influencer-discovery)

<https://youtu.be/7d10K1GN3S8?si=Oyb3cKVln2etPi6K> 

---

# **❌ The Problem**

Influencer marketing is no longer a nice-to-have - it's a core growth channel. But finding the right creators is still painfully manual.

The current process looks like this: you open a platform, set some filters (follower count, category, location), scroll through hundreds of profiles, and then manually watch their content to figure out if they're actually a good fit. Does their aesthetic match our brand? Have they worked with competitors? Do they tell stories in a way that resonates with our audience?

These are the questions that matter most, and none of them show up in metadata.

Traditional discovery tools search profiles. They can tell you a creator has 50K followers in the beauty category. But they can't tell you whether that creator films in a warm, cozy bedroom aesthetic or a bright studio setup. They can't tell you that a creator mentioned your competitor's product in a GRWM last Tuesday, without a hashtag or tag.

---

# **🛠 How Syncly Solves This**

Syncly Social analyzes what's actually happening inside the content – every frame, every word, every sound. Instead of filtering by metadata, you describe what you're looking for in natural language, and Syncly finds creators whose content matches.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99264&key=user_uploads/971454/5f564bfa-9007-4d33-8a16-a08eef2493ae)

### Here's what you can search by:

* **Visual mood & aesthetic** - "clean minimal apartment with natural lighting"
* **Creator persona** - "fitness-forward creator, athletic build, gym setting"
* **Content format** - "GRWM morning routine" or "before-and-after transformation"
* **Spoken mentions** - find creators who organically mention your brand in their videos, no tags required
* **Storytelling style** - conversational, educational, high-energy, or laid-back
* This means you can find creators that genuinely fit your brand's identity - not just creators who check the right demographic boxes. And because you never have to watch a single video yourself, it scales.

---

# **🏢 Who This Is For**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99264&key=user_uploads/971454/38e3c357-5fb2-4172-97e7-85fc6eba9532)

**Brand marketers:** Find creators who match your brand's specific criteria - visual style, tone, values - without spending hours on manual research. Just describe what you want and get results.

**Agencies:** Turn vague client briefs into concrete creator shortlists. Discover rising creators early and deliver them to clients before anyone else does.

---

# **🚀 Try It Now**

Creator Discovery on Syncly Social is live and free to try:

👉[ **Start your free trial**](https://social.syncly.app/login?utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=influencer-discovery)

If you want a personalized walkthrough or want to see how it works for your specific use case:

👉[ **Book a demo**](https://syncly.app/demo?utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=influencer-discovery) - book a demo through this link, and we'll include a social listening audit + personalized creator discovery session.

launches.title: Syncly Social - AI social listening platform for modern brands
launches.body:
Introducing [Syncly Social](https://www.syncly.app) - AI social listening platform for modern brands. We aggregate reviews, posts, and conversations from socials and e-commerce (Amazon, Instagram, Reddit, retailer-specific reviews, and many more) for market, competitor, and consumer intelligence, and provide actionable insights, faster and more accurate than ever.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87956&key=user_uploads/971454/f0894f43-dfd0-4b93-bb57-828ad0328971)

# **Challenges of Social listening platform 1.0**

**High volume of Noise data:** Legacy platforms rely on simple keyword queries to gather data. The problems are:

* **Time-consuming**: Takes up to a couple of months to setup, repetitively.
* **Less than 10% data is relevant:** For example, product names or sub-brands with generic or common imagery (like Discover and United) can lead to irrelevant content being collected.

**Lack of Granularity in Analysis:**

* Let’s say "picture quality" may be frequently mentioned for mobile brand. So what? To translate that into specific product or marketing insights, the insight should be more granular, but what you can get from legacy platform is the summary, at most, like “_People generally praise the picture quality on Samsung phones, particularly on their high-end models.”_

**One-Dimensional Sentiment Analysis:** Traditional sentiment analysis often fails to capture the full context, especially when posts contain mixed emotions.

* For example, a review that says, "It’s not as bright as {product name}" might seem negative, but since {product name} is a brand’s another product, it isn’t necessarily a critique of the brand as a whole. This inaccuracy complicates efforts to identify precise product improvements or refine marketing messages.

# **Why we need Social listening platform 2.0 - Syncly social**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87956&key=user_uploads/971454/daffa167-4b77-47ae-8b0a-edf4809e5be5)

* **⚡️ 90% Faster Setup:** Forget tedious keyword lists of what to include and exclude that often take up to a couple of months🤯. Syncly's AI automatically filters irrelevant chatter.
* **🎯 Hyper-Targeted Insights:** Brands went _beyond_ basic sentiment to identify specific product issues and opportunities.
* **😊 Nuanced Sentiment Analysis:** Syncly pinpointed _exactly_ which features customers loved (or hated) with aspect-based analysis.
* **🌎 Language Agnostic Brand Tracking:** Global consumer brands, like LG Electronics, could track brand mentions in different languages without needing to translate keywords.

# **Impact**

Insights that once took **months** now surface in just **days**, enabling your brand to refine products, optimize marketing, and stay ahead of competitors, fast.

# **Learn more use case**

If you’re interested in learning more use cases how Modern brands achieve competitive advantage through social listening, [schedule a demo](https://www.syncly.app/demo) with me.

launches.title: Syncly - Get product insights from everyday customer communication for fast-growing companies
launches.tagline: Bringing AI to help CX and Product team to understand customer issues before they churn.
launches.body:
[Syncly](https://syncly.app/) is an AI customer feedback analysis platform. I know you are running a customer-driven product. But do you understand in detail what’s driving negative customer sentiment and what needs to be done to elevate the experience?

Here’s how Syncly helps top B2C companies like:

* **Logitech, Boundless, Gamma,** and many others

and fast-growing YC companies like:

* **Speak**, **Ello**, **Navattic**, and many others.

# **The Challenge: Do you know what’s driving negative customer experiences on your product and how to address them?**

It’s difficult to get visibility into the user sentiment trends and what can be done to elevate customer experience from a product perspective. Even when you get it, it’s not actionable. Why?

* **Product insight is not granular enough:** unable to pinpoint customers/customer groups at risk and understand the details of their issues on your product.
* **It takes loads of manual effort** to read and analyze customer feedback data. By the time you have it, it’s too late. Tagging provides stats but no story.
* **Scattered data sources:** Difficult to aggregate various customer touch points (i.e., Zendesk, Intercom, Front, [gong.io](http://gong.io), Slack, Discord, reviews, and many others)

# **The Solution: Syncly AI surfaces trending/urgent product** **issues automatically, based on all your customer touch points. Syncly does it with minimal effort from users and provides a granular level of insight on a customer level.**

* With [**Smart Insight**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HsoTigJI9F4), identify the most critical product gaps and issues that hinder customer experience without having to read all customer interactions across multiple channels (Zendesk, Intercom, gong.io, Front, Slack, Discord, reviews, and others).
* Ask **Syncly AI** to pinpoint the positive and negative sentiment drivers and get instant action items to elevate the customer experience.
* With **Customers AI**, monitor sentiment trends by account and individual user, to proactively engage with customers with underlying issues before they become at-risk.

  ![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/uTiFzlfEY2imgMwq5c8r1XDKCrE.png)


### Learn more use cases

If you’re interested in learning more use cases and getting a free trial:

* [**schedule a call**](https://www.syncly.app/demo) with Co-Founders at Syncly!

launches.title: 🚀 Syncly — AI customer feedback analytics that drives retention
launches.tagline: Syncly enables Revenue teams to better understand customer insights to drive retention and team productivity.
launches.body:
Hey, We are Joseph, Kwan, Jongsoo from [Syncly](https://www.syncly.app) (YC W23).

Our team founded and sold an AI startup for $200M, and decided to bring our technology to help Revenue team drive retention by delivering the right value for customers.

### **TL;DR**

Syncly uses AI and Chat-GPT to enable Revenue teams to better understand customer insights to drive retention and team productivity.

### **The Challenge**

* **Manual tagging and insights:** Your revenue team wants to understand the most impactful product or operational feedback, but the team spend a lot of time manually aggregating and analyzing. As a result, you come to learn what had gone wrong _AFTER_ the damage.
* **Measuring team efficiency**: Hard to track most of what problems your Revenue team is doing, but seems your team is doing a lot. Currently, done by 1-on-1 meetings or manual tagging, which is not scalable.
* **Post-action impact:** Hard to measure how customer feedback has changed after certain actions.

### **The Solution**

* **Automating feedback insight:** Syncly finds urgent and impactful customer issues. Your team can proactively engage with customers _BEFORE_ the damage.
* **Boosting team efficiency:** Spread best practices within the organization to help Account managers, Customer success & support managers focus on delivering more value to the customer.
* **Post-action visibility:** By monitoring customer feedback trend, you can measure the impact of each release and action.

\*Syncly’s integrations include **Intercom, Slack, Salesforce**, and other customer communication platforms.
